content: If an OBDDataIdentifier contains support information (presence of DcmDspDidDataSupportInfo container), the Dcm shall calculate the support in- formation value according to the available data for this DID : for every DcmDspData container existing for this DID , the associated support information bits, referenced in DcmDspDidDataSupportInfo , shall be set to one.
